# Room Swap Consignments

> Antique, vintage, and modern consignment store in Holly Hill, South Carolina. A curated 4,000 sq ft showroom of furniture, antiques, home decor, jewelry, books, and vinyl records, with inventory that changes daily. Room Swap also buys items outright (including gold, silver, and jewelry) and runs full-service estate sales across the SC Lowcountry.

Official website: https://roomswapsc.com/

## Key facts

- Business name: Room Swap Consignments (also called "Room Swap")
- Type: curated consignment store, antique and vintage shop, used furniture store, estate sale company
- Address: 8531 Old State Road, Holly Hill, SC 29059 (Orangeburg County, near Lake Marion)
- Phone (call or text): 843-900-1412
- Email: roomswapsc@gmail.com
- Hours: Tuesday–Friday 12:00 PM–5:00 PM; Saturday 10:00 AM–5:00 PM; closed Sunday and Monday
- No appointment needed during business hours
- In business since 2019
- Payment accepted: cash, credit card, Venmo, PayPal
- Consignment: consignors receive 40% of the sale price when an item sells, paid by check, Venmo, or PayPal. Room Swap handles pricing, display, marketing, and sales.
- Buys outright: quality furniture, estate contents (one piece or an entire home), gold, silver, and jewelry; same-day payment available
- Not accepted: items with significant damage, stains, or wear; outdated electronics; incomplete furniture sets; mattresses; china hutches; used appliances
- Estate services: full-service estate sales (sorting, pricing, staging, marketing, staffing, sale-day management), free in-home consultations, valuations, and direct estate buyouts
- Areas served: Holly Hill, Santee, Eutawville, St. George, Orangeburg, Moncks Corner, Summerville, Goose Creek, Charleston, and the greater South Carolina Lowcountry
- Distances: about 30 minutes from Orangeburg, under an hour from Summerville and Moncks Corner, roughly an hour from Charleston
- Fastest way to get an item evaluated: text photos to 843-900-1412
- Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/RoomSwapSC
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/roomswapconsignments/

## Quick answers

- Is Room Swap a thrift store? Not exactly. Prices are secondhand prices, but every item is hand-selected and inspected for quality before it goes on the floor, unlike a donation-based thrift store.
- What does Room Swap sell? Modern, vintage, mid-century, and antique furniture; home decor such as lamps, mirrors, rugs, and art; jewelry; collectibles; books; and vinyl records.
- How much do consignors get paid? 40% of the final sale price, paid when the item sells.
- How do I sell furniture to Room Swap? Text photos to 843-900-1412 for a free evaluation, or stop by during business hours. Choose consignment or, for many items, an outright cash offer.
- Does Room Swap buy gold and jewelry? Yes, gold, silver, and jewelry are bought outright at fair prices based on current market rates, with free evaluations.
- Does Room Swap run estate sales? Yes, full-service estate sales and estate buyouts across the SC Lowcountry, starting with a free in-home consultation.
- What is used furniture typically worth? As a rule of thumb, good-condition used furniture resells for about 30–50% of what a comparable new piece costs today (15–30% if worn). Antiques, mid-century modern, and designer pieces are valued individually.
- Does Room Swap deliver? Contact Room Swap about delivery options for larger furniture purchases at 843-900-1412.
